Annotation Interface TestSubject

@Target(FIELD) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented public @interface TestSubject
Annotation to set on a field so that EasyMockRunner, EasyMockRule or EasyMockSupport.injectMocks(Object) will inject mocks created with Mock on its fields.

See EasyMockSupport.injectMocks(Object) for the injection rules.
